# Invest Gulf

> Independent research on UAE and Gulf property investment for foreign buyers: fees, yields, Golden Visa, off-plan risks, and cross-market comparisons.

- Site: https://invest-gulf.com
- Contact: info@invest-gulf.com
- Updated: 2026-08-21
- Focus: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait property investment
- Not a developer, not a broker, not a listing portal, independent editorial
- Publisher: Invest Gulf Editorial (independent; not affiliated with developers or government bodies)
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140471703

## Entity Disambiguation

**Invest Gulf is an independent research publication.** Not to be confused with:
- UAE government entities or official Gulf investment bodies
- "Gulf Invest" or similar brokerage names in the region
- Any developer portal, listing site, or off-plan sales platform

Invest Gulf publishes data-driven guides on property yields, fees, Golden Visa pathways, off-plan risks, and cross-market comparisons for foreign buyers in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and Oman. All content is editorial, no developer sponsorship, no listing commissions.
